report.summary: Reviewed the exact reader (scripts/verify-evidence-export.mjs readEvidenceFile), the CLI dispatch (scripts/verify-revision-audit.mjs lines 10-14), the signed wrapper (lib/issued-revision-audit.ts envelope/verifier), the receipt verifier (lib/evidence-issuer.ts), and the unsigned verifier/digest (lib/revision-audit.ts) plus the CLI tests. The dispatch rule itself matches the stated contract: rows whose schema equals ISSUED_REVISION_AUDIT_SCHEMA, or that own 'audit' or 'receipt' (including assigned schema, inherited key, or null), are routed to verifyIssuedRevisionAudit; receipt failure returns consistency 'inconsistent' with issuance.status 'invalid' and never retries as unsigned; a pure unsigned core (no audit/receipt/schema fields) yields issuance.status 'unproven' with exit 0 when consistent. Exit codes follow the unsigned report's consistency (0 consistent, 1 inconsistent, 2 unsupported). One concrete defect stands: malformed receipts or envelopes lose the specific receipt reason and are all reported as reason 'invalid_receipt', which makes 'missing-receipt' indistinguishable from a structurally valid-but-wrong signature and breaks expected reporting for the tested rejection kinds. No other reachable correctness defect was established from the packet alone.

findings.title: Receipt verification is skipped when base audit is inconsistent, collapsing specific reasons and making 'digest_mismatch' a false label
findings.evidence: Line 23: `const issuance=base.consistency==="consistent"?await receiptVerifier(await revisionAuditDigest(captured.audit),captured.receipt):{status:"invalid",reason:"digest_mismatch"} as EvidenceIssuerVerification;`. When the signed envelope passes `envelope()` (exact keys, schema OK) but the inner audit is inconsistent, the receipt verifier never runs. Every such case reports `reason:"digest_mismatch"` even though no digest comparison was made, so a wrong-keyId or forged-signature receipt on a tampered audit is mislabeled. The opposite error occurs for the missing-receipt case: `envelope()` fails at line 11 (keys `audit|schema` != `audit|receipt|schema`) and the catch at lines 18-20 returns `issuance:{status:"invalid",reason:"invalid_receipt"}` without calling the receipt verifier, so `tests/revision-audit.test.ts:77` `missing-receipt` only sees the generic reason and cannot distinguish it from 'unknown_key', 'signature_invalid', or a non-string receipt. The test asserts only `status==="invalid"`, so it passes despite the mislabeling.
findings.reproduction: Unverified inference (no execution): take a consistent issued audit E, delete its receipt key (or set receipt to `{}`), and run `node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-revision-audit.mjs missing.json`; the report has `issuance.reason === "invalid_receipt"` and exit 1, the same as if receipt were `{}`. Conversely flip a byte in E.audit and keep a valid receipt: the report says `reason:"digest_mismatch"` although `receiptVerifier` was never invoked. Real reason discrimination would require a JSON file with a valid-shaped receipt as in tests line 76; the CLI cannot report whether the receipt was structurally valid or was a known key with a bad signature.
findings.suggestion: Track whether `envelope()` failed on a missing/malformed receipt vs a missing/malformed audit, or on audit inconsistency, and report the receipt reason the verifier would return; minimally, use a distinct reason such as `audit_inconsistent` (not `digest_mismatch`) when the receipt was not checked, and a distinct reason (`missing_or_malformed_receipt`) when `envelope()` failed only on the receipt key, so callers can tell that situation apart from a present-but-invalid receipt.

limitations: Only the files in the supplied source packet were reviewed; helper modules not in the packet (evidence-bundle.ts assertEvidenceBundleBudget/evidenceBundleSha256, evidence-issuer-keys.ts EVIDENCE_ISSUER_KEYS, evidence-export.ts, static-project.ts) were not inspected, so their internal behavior is assumed from call sites in the packet.
No runtime checks, tests, or commands were executed (read-only review); all reproductions are labeled reasoning traces.
Production key pinning and private-key configuration were not supplied, so absence of pinning or key mismatch in production cannot be inferred from the omitted evidence-issuer-keys.ts.
